newsitem.title: UK: UK Feb-Apr primary fuel output falls 1.4 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: UK Feb-Apr primary fuel output falls 1.4 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Britain's primary fuel production in the three months from February to April fell by 1.4 percent from the same period in 1996, provisional Department of Trade and Industry figures showed on Tuesday.
In the three-monthly total of 74.1 million tonnes of oil equivalent, primary electricity production rose by 10.7 percent while physical oil output rose by 1.7 percent.
Coal production fell by 3.2 percent in the same period, according to ministry figures, while natural gas output fell by 7.6 percent.

"This increase in primary electricity production reflected increased output from nuclear stations of 9.6 percent, where more Magnox stations were available compared with a year earlier," a ministry statement said.
